description: DKIM/SPF/DMARC verification results recorded by an SMTP-in bridge. Per ADR-2605172200.

dkimDomain.description: d= tag from the DKIM-Signature header that produced the verifying signature.

spfMailfrom.description: RFC 5321 MAIL FROM domain used for SPF.

dmarcPolicy.description: p= policy declared by the From-domain DMARC record at evaluation time.

spamScore.description: Bridge-computed spam score; lower = more confident. Bridge-specific scale; clients SHOULD treat <1.0 as clean and >5.0 as likely spam.
